_about: FIBO 2.0 VGL template for a keeper portrait (owner S7). Pick a keeper, paste its objects_entry and portrait.background_setting from art/keepers/<id>.yaml verbatim, write every per_image field, keep every fixed field verbatim, and send only structured_prompt to the node. The disclosure ships beside the picture in HTML, never inside it. Rules: art/DIRECTION.md, 'The keepers'.
route: Comfy Cloud Bria node api_bria_fibo2_t2i; allowed only after Comfy's written confirmation (art/LICENSES.md)

node.seed: {an integer of 1 or more; record it with the render}
node.source: get_node on Comfy Cloud, 2026-11-02, recorded in baseline/v2/art-DIRECTION.md (Sizes on the Bria node)

structured_prompt.short_description: {one or two sentences: the keeper, what it is doing, and where}

objects.relationship: {the only subject; the room behind is soft}
objects.pose: {half body, standing, the prop held clear of the face}
objects.action: {what the keeper is doing with its prop}

lighting.conditions: luminous golden light from glowing lanterns and a low warm sun, with a soft warm underglow on the face
lighting.direction: {where the warm key light comes from: the keeper's own lantern, a window or a hearth}

aesthetics.composition: half-body portrait, centered and facing the viewer, the figure built from two or three bold shapes, with clear space around the head for a round crop and a soft, low-detail background
aesthetics.color_scheme: warm cream and honey gold with ember orange, copper and hammered bronze, gold inlaid in cool pink-grey granite, and one clear note of Colorado sky blue

photographic_characteristics.focus: sharp focus on the keeper's face and prop

structured_prompt.style_medium: stylized hand-painted high-fantasy illustration with a few bold, chunky shapes, sturdy exaggerated proportions, thick confident outlines, visible painted brush texture and soft cel shading
structured_prompt.context: a character portrait of a friendly fantasy keeper for a community website's team page, later cropped to a half-body card and a round avatar
